keywords.label: spec
keywords.documentation: Declares mathematical specifications and formal properties to be statically checked or runtime-asserted.

keywords.label: contract
keywords.documentation: Defines software contracts containing pre-conditions (`requires`), post-conditions (`ensures`), and invariants (`invariant`).

keywords.label: requires
keywords.documentation: Specifies a boolean precondition that must be true before entering the associated function or scope.

keywords.label: ensures
keywords.documentation: Specifies a boolean postcondition guaranteed to hold upon exit from the associated function or scope.

keywords.label: invariant
keywords.documentation: Specifies an invariant condition that remains universally true across state changes.

keywords.label: nexus
keywords.documentation: Declares a lock-free or buffered concurrent communication nexus between tasks or hardware pipelines.

keywords.label: quantum
keywords.documentation: Begins a lightweight cooperative execution quantum that can yield execution explicitly using `yield_to`.

keywords.label: yield_to
keywords.documentation: Yields control from current quantum fiber to the specified target fiber or runtime scheduler.

keywords.label: region
keywords.documentation: Creates a scoped memory arena. Allocations inside the region are fast pointer bumps and freed in O(1) time at scope boundary.

keywords.label: morph
keywords.documentation: Safely reinterprets a raw byte stream or contiguous span into a typed header or packet without allocation.

keywords.label: isolate
keywords.documentation: Enters an uninterruptible hardware isolated critical execution section with interrupts masked.

keywords.label: hazard
keywords.documentation: Protects a pointer from concurrent deallocation during lock-free data structure traversal.

keywords.label: claim
keywords.documentation: Claims and pins a hazard pointer value, preventing epoch reclamation during reader execution.

keywords.label: pin
keywords.documentation: Pins a variable or reference to a fixed physical address or MMIO register.

keywords.label: gpu_kernel
keywords.documentation: Marks a function as a GPU compute kernel to be compiled to Vulkan SPIR-V, CUDA PTX, or Metal MSL.

keywords.label: gpu_dispatch
keywords.documentation: Dispatches a GPU kernel across a 1D, 2D, or 3D compute grid.

keywords.label: defer
keywords.documentation: Defers execution of the statement or block until the enclosing scope exits.

keywords.label: own
keywords.documentation: Specifies exclusive affine heap ownership with no aliasing. Can only be moved, never cloned implicitly.

keywords.label: lent
keywords.documentation: Represents an explicitly lent resource whose caller guarantees borrow lifetime without lockups.

keywords.label: ref
keywords.documentation: Creates a safe shared reference to a value.

keywords.label: vector
keywords.documentation: Fixed-width SIMD hardware vector of element type T and lane count N (e.g. vector<f32, 4>, vector<i32, 8>).

keywords.label: device_span
keywords.documentation: Non-owning view over contiguous memory accessible from both CPU host and GPU device.

functions.label: println
functions.documentation: Prints formatted text followed by a newline to standard output.

functions.label: print
functions.documentation: Prints formatted text to standard output without trailing newline.

functions.label: move
functions.documentation: Explicitly relinquishes ownership and transfers the affine resource.

functions.label: panic
functions.documentation: Halts execution with a runtime panic message and stack trace.

functions.label: assert
functions.detail: fn assert(cond: bool, msg: str) -> void
functions.documentation: Asserts that the condition is true; panics with msg if false.

functions.label: sizeof
functions.documentation: Returns compile-time byte size of type T.

functions.label: atomic_load
functions.documentation: Performs an atomic load with sequentially consistent memory ordering.

functions.label: atomic_store
functions.detail: fn atomic_store<T>(ptr: *mut T, val: T) -> void
functions.documentation: Performs an atomic store with sequentially consistent memory ordering.

functions.label: mmio_read32
functions.documentation: Reads a 32-bit hardware register via volatile memory-mapped I/O.

functions.label: mmio_write32
functions.detail: fn mmio_write32(addr: usize, val: u32) -> void
functions.documentation: Writes a 32-bit value to a hardware register via volatile memory-mapped I/O.
